name: asadin-edu-kimialoka
description: Kimialoka · Asadin Edu — open, bilingual interactive chemistry encyclopedia and learning platform: matter, particles, atoms, elements, isotopes, ions, molecules, materials, reactions and every branch of chemistry, from primary school to university.

scripts.sync: node scripts/sync-molecules.mjs && node scripts/sync-elements.mjs && node scripts/sync-ions.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/build-topics.mjs && node scripts/build-refs.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.build:check: node scripts/build-topics.mjs --check && node scripts/build-refs.mjs --check && node scripts/build-sw.mjs --check
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run build:site && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev dist --port 8788 --compatibility-date=2026-09-21
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run data:check && npm run build:check && npm test
